title: Match the technique to what it improves
summary: Which serving technique addresses which bottleneck.

prompts.text: Separate prefill and decode GPU pools

options.text: The tokenizer splits words into too many tokens
A 30,000-token prompt freezes everyone's token stream for a second
Every request recomputes the same 2,000-token system prompt
Short replies wait for the longest reply in their batch to finish
A single user at batch size 1 gets too few tokens per second
The model barely fits and decode is bound by reading weights
One pool cannot meet both a TTFT target and a TPOT target at a good cost
